#################### DSSP8 dataset Description #################################################
#         DSSP8 is a secondary structure datasets with Eight states (H,B,E,G,I,T,S,C). There
#         are 17608 Non-Redundant chains (25%). This dataset was created by DSSP & Blastclust.
#         PDB resolution is maximum 3 Angstrom and PDB chain length is minimum 80 amino acid.
#         There are three line in each PDB, First line is PDB ID with chain,
#         Second is amino acid sequence in single letter code and
#         third line is assignment of  Eight states (H,B,E,G,I,T,S,C) secondary
#         structure at each amino acid residue corresponding to amino acid of respective PDB
#         sequence, where, H=alpha helix, B=a beta bridge, E=Extended beta sheet, G=3/10 helix,
#         I=pi helix, T=hydrogen bonded turn, S=bend, C=coil.
#################### Dataset Description end    ################################################
